name: 01 — Daily Scrape & Match
_note: SANITIZED snapshot of the LIVE n8n Cloud workflow (id ZZPsOF8vwttSIuZz). Cloud-native: Apify HTTP + Code + Supabase nodes (does NOT call the host agents). Secrets redacted — replace YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN and YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY before importing. Telegram uses $env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. This file is a reference export and is NOT auto-synced to cloud.

parameters.jsCode: const results=$input.all();const KW=["ai","ml","machine learning","genai","llm","nlp","data scientist","mlops","deep learning","generative","foundation model"];const hasAI=t=>{const l=(t||"").toLowerCase();return KW.some(k=>l.includes(k));};const jobs=[];const seen=new Set();for(const item of results){const r=item.json||{};const url=r.url||"";if(!url)continue;let company="",atsType="";if(url.includes("boards.greenhouse.io")){const m=url.match(/boards\.greenhouse\.io\/([^\/]+)/);if(m){company=m[1];atsType="greenhouse";}}else if(url.includes("jobs.lever.co")){const m=url.match(/jobs\.lever\.co\/([^\/]+)/);if(m){company=m[1];atsType="lever";}}else if(url.includes("jobs.ashbyhq.com")){const m=url.match(/jobs\.ashbyhq\.com\/([^\/]+)/);if(m){company=m[1];atsType="ashby";}}if(!company||seen.has(url)||!hasAI(r.title||""))continue;seen.add(url);jobs.push({company:company.replace(/-/g," ").replace(/\b\w/g,l=>l.toUpperCase()),role:(r.title||"").replace(/^Job Application for /,"").replace(/ at .+$/,""),jd_url:url,jd_text:(r.snippet||"").slice(0,2000),ats_type:atsType,location:"India",status:"scraped"});}return jobs.length?jobs.map(j=>({json:j})):[{json:{jd_url:"",status:"scraped"}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "chat_id": $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, "text": "Daily Job Agent run complete. Jobs scraped, inserted and scored — check your dashboard for new matches.", "parse_mode": "Markdown" } }}
